prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Lulla Faespring. Character visual motifs: unnervingly calm adult moth archivist with a quilted cloak, waist-hung mechanical bedside clocks and large glass chime ring.
TOP LEFT: Drowse Ledger. Ability concept: an enemy champion completing a **non-basic-attack ability** within 95 GU of an active Lulla chime accumulates one Drowse note (max 2, 4 s duration). Each unique cast can add at most one note. Notes do not affect the cast that just finished.
TOP RIGHT: Hang the Chime. Ability concept: places a 2-HP wind chime on legal ground within 125 GU, lasting 5 s. It projects a public 95-GU listening radius. Max two chimes; destroying a chime ends its aura but does not retroactively cancel completed spells.
BOTTOM LEFT: Borrowed Yawn. Ability concept: consumes one Drowse note on an enemy in 130 GU. On that enemy's **next successfully completed non-basic spell** within 3 s, adds **0.35 s post-cast recovery** after the spell's effect already resolves; if no valid cast happens, the tax expires harmlessly. No silence, disable, cast failure or stealth.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Intermission Theater. Ability concept: opens an 135-GU circular dream stage for 4 s, with **three announced chime beats** at 1, 2, and 3 s. Enemy casts which *complete inside* a beat window pay 0.25 s post-cast recovery (subject to the global recovery cap), while allied casts completed during beats gain 12% shorter recovery (never faster windup). Enemy spell results and damage still occur normally.
